description: Agent runtime composition root for Agentic OS
pre_install: Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.505.0/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aoscompose-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '9831db4dfb982acd2f51127b8c28f936eee44a24f02a73e1fe57cda819213b3e') { throw 'aoscompose checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.505.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '23903a2a102aaf6524af956639908e8704b331243f27f9bda0336e134e466106') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
